seo.metaTitle: Image format converter & resizer — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Open iPhone photos anywhere. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/image/heic-to-jpg-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Image format converter & resizer processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/image/heic-to-jpg-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Image format converter & resizer upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Image format converter & resizer executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/image/heic-to-jpg-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Image format converter & resizer?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/heic_to_jpg.json or open /tools/heic-to-jpg?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
